definitions.short: Lachmi , an Israelite; or rather probably a brief form
definitions.full: H3902. Lachmi לִחֲמִי proper name, masculine brother of Goliath of Gath (q. v.) slain by Elhanan, according to 1Chr 20:5 את לחמי ; ᵐ5 Ελεμεε , Λεεμει , Λοομι ); original reading probably (as in || 2Sam 21:19 ) הַלַּחְמִי בֵּית q. v. above.
